coverage: Direct buying by defence bodies, as published on TED and the national portals we read; not the sub-tier needs of prime contractors, which are not published. TED covers about a tenth of EU defence spending (a 2025 ECIPE policy brief; we have not re-checked that figure). National coverage differs: Spain (PLACSP) and Poland (e-Zamówienia) in full, Germany (the federal procurement office's portal) since 2025, France (BOAMP) since late 2023, the Netherlands (TenderNed) with one defence buyer.
winnersFrom: Winners are those named in TED result notices and in PLACSP's award results (Spain); a winner published in both is counted once. Natural persons are never counted or named.
